title: MonoBridge
description: Flexing and Fear the Chimps Bridge Mod. Maybe a hybrid regex for other guilds
body:
## Give BridgeChat a fresh new look with **MonoBridge**!

**MonoBridge** makes BridgeChat cleaner, easier to read, and more enjoyable to use by improving how messages are displayed in-game. It also adds useful quality-of-life features to help you manage your chat experience.

### Current features include:
- Improved BridgeChat message formatting.
- Ignore players you don't want to see, similar to /ignore, but for BridgeChat messages.
- Cleaner, more readable chat with a polished look.
- Lightweight and designed to fit naturally into your game.

MonoBridge doesn't replace BridgeChat; it enhances it, giving you a cleaner interface and more control over the conversations you see.
